major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send Deathmark on cooldown once Garrote and Rupture are both ticking, Envenom's buff has more than 2 seconds left and Kingsbane is within 2 seconds of ready, then stack trinkets, racials and a potion into its 16-second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 360194 is the cast id; the debuff shares the name in logs.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it immediately after Deathmark with Garrote and Rupture ticking and Envenom up, since the duplicated poison applications ramp its 14-second dot far faster; otherwise only send it on cooldown when Deathmark is more than 52 seconds away.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Vanish exists to enable Improved Garrote: send it inside Deathmark and immediately Garrote so the empowered bleed lands with its damage doubled, or hold it in Mythic+ for a chainpull where you cannot stealth beforehand.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1856 is the cast; 11327 is the Vanish aura in logs.

major_cooldowns.name: Shiv
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: With Toxic Stiletto its energy cost is low enough to be the cheapest last combo point: press it while Darkest Night is up when you are 1 combo point from the cap and fighting 3 or fewer enemies, rather than wasting a Mutilate.

major_cooldowns.name: Thistle Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Each charge restores 100 energy on a 60-second recharge across 3 charges, and the priority forces one out when energy drops below half with under 10 seconds left in the fight so no charge is wasted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Base cd column lists 60s recharge with 3 charges.

rule.description: Garrote stays up on your main target
rule.action: Keep Garrote ticking on your main target at all times: refresh it when it becomes refreshable and you are at least 1 combo point from the cap, and re-apply it during Vanish so the Improved Garrote version is the one rolling through Deathmark, which doubles it.

rule.description: Rupture stays up on your main target
rule.action: Keep Rupture ticking on your main target; it and Garrote are the highest priority before any filler, and Deathmark doubles both, so never enter a burst window with either one down.

rule.description: Rupture only at 5 or more combo points
rule.action: Only refresh Rupture at 5 or more combo points, and only when the target will live more than 12 seconds past the current duration.

rule.description: Envenom only at 5 or more combo points
rule.action: Spend Envenom at 5 or more combo points. The one exception is Implacable at 80 stacks: let the Envenom buff expire there for the 80% energy regeneration burst, unless you are in Bloodlust or 8 or more target AoE where you would just overcap energy.

Cast Deathmark first, then Kingsbane immediately after: Deathmark applies every lethal poison twice, which ramps Kingsbane's 14-second dot far higher. If Deathmark is not up, only send Kingsbane when Deathmark is more than 52 seconds away.

In single target, Vanish inside an active Deathmark and Garrote straight away so the empowered Improved Garrote gets the 100% Deathmark bonus. Only break the pairing when Deathmark will not come back before the target dies, or in Mythic+ when you need the restealth for a chainpull.

rule.description: Garrote into Rupture, then Deathmark to Kingsbane
rule.action: Open from stealth with Garrote, Mutilate to 5 or more combo points, Rupture, re-Garrote to extend Improved Garrote, build back to 5 and Envenom before entering cooldowns, then trinkets and racials, Deathmark, Kingsbane, and Envenom again to dump combo points.

rule.description: Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds in AoE
rule.action: On 2 or more targets, build with Crimson Tempest until every enemy has your bleeds or you reach 5 or more combo points; it is your only way to spread Garrote and Rupture, including Improved Garrote, and at 60 energy it is too expensive to press in single target.

rule.description: Mutilate gives way to Fan of Knives in AoE
rule.action: Drop Mutilate once 2 or more enemies are up, 3 or more with Blindside, and generate with Fan of Knives and Crimson Tempest instead. With the Mythic+ build you press Fan of Knives even in single target and only Mutilate once Unshakeable Drive is above 2 stacks.

rule.description: Darkest Night spent with a max combo Envenom
rule.action: Playing Deathstalker, always spend Darkest Night with an Envenom at maximum combo points; it is also the only way to move Deathstalker's Mark, so plan the spend around target swaps and use Shiv for the last combo point at 3 or fewer enemies.
